## Texts and drawings (2)

- **E0775** (description, sure): 卧云轩. Wikipedia text, a lead · zh.wikipedia 绮春园 list in the 圆明园 page · S06. https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/圆明园
  Named among the buildings of the middle of Qichun Yuan, with 展诗应律, 春泽斋, 生冬室. S380 repeats it. No Qing passage on disk.
- **E0756** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 生冬室. 2020 edition · v4 p.287 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=290
  The core of Prince Yi's garden, with Qianlong's 1740 plaque 明善堂. Jiaqing rebuilt it as 含淳堂 and renamed it 生冬室: seven bays with annexes and a stage inside, used by dowagers. 菡萏榭 stands south-east, and 卧云轩 (also 四面云山), a three-bay open hall, on an islet in the pool.
